newsitem.title: USA: CCC buys 1,625 tonnes of commodities for Moldova.
newsitem.headline: CCC buys 1,625 tonnes of commodities for Moldova.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corp (CCC) of the U.S. Agriculture Department bought 1,625 tonnes of commodities for June 6-20 shipment for donation to Moldova.
CCC bought 255 tonnes of pinto beans for $402.03 per tonne from Berdex International Inc and 605 tonnes of sunflower oil for $943.60 per tonne from Cal Western Packaging Corp.
CCC also said it bought 510 tonnes of bulgur wheat for $260.14 per tonne from Lauhoff Grain Co and 255 tonnes of wheat-soy blend for $460.13 per tonne from ADM Milling Company.
